note: Sixth review of 1.24.13: 94 sketches, kept as templates (expanded by tests/review6_lib.js), that try to make Lantern's sketch runner reach the page, hang it, or run out of memory: names like __proto__ and constructor, 100,000 nested brackets, macros that double, recursion, writes to ever-new slots, 2,300 lines naming the Stop. On the build it was given none reached the page; 6 took over 2 s or crashed (S33, S38, S65, S68, S68b, S74). Replayed by tests/bench_1253.js (all but S33, a right sketch in 1 MB of blank lines, whose minute is spent in the bench's older reply parser).
